1.

Lord, Thou art our strength, This we perceive. In days of weakness here, Strength in Thee we find.

C.

Near Thee, near Thee, Help us to abide, Till with the great redeemed throng Glory to Thee we give.

2.

Jesus, Thou who for us died, Thou art the fountain of life; Freely, open to each one, Grace’s streams do flow.

3.

Water in the desert is not found, But Thou dost grant us With joy to draw therefrom The wells of salvation.

4.

Lord, Thou art our praise, Strength in the weak, Forward in the world of light Thou wilt draw Thy people.
